specification: Wrong role: a user without the required role attempts an approval or restricted read. Expected: denied, no state change or sensitive-data disclosure, auditable denial.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Changed evidence: a previously reviewed subject is revised. Expected: earlier decision remains attached to the earlier version; handling of the revised version follows the confirmed revision policy. Do not assume every harmless edit requires every approval again.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Duplicate handoff: replay an identical event. Expected: one business effect, traceable repeated attempts.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Unknown outcome: a timeout follows possible destination acceptance. Expected: unresolved state and receipt reconciliation before replay, not blind duplication.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Restart recovery: restart after a queued event but before confirmed receipt. Expected: recover outstanding item without losing evidence or creating a duplicate effect.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Out-of-order input: milestone completion arrives before its baseline. Expected: held for reconciliation, no invented linkage or downstream accounting action.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Missing mapping/rate: absent Finance rule/input. Expected: explicit exception, not zero, default rate, guessed BU or balancing plug.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Restricted export: an internal report contains payroll/commercial/internal issue details. Expected: external version follows an approved allowed-field and review policy; no raw internal copy is sent.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Unresolved emergency policy: an emergency change requests an assumed GLPI bypass. Expected: no invented waiver; route remains explicitly blocked pending the authority decision.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Notification sink: every notification in mock mode targets an internal fake sink. Expected: zero real email, client message, invoice posting, transfer, live project update or deployment.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Source drift: a source file or rule version changes. Expected: identify affected definitions/results and require deliberate revalidation; do not silently rewrite the immutable baseline.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Recovery copy: extract release archive into an empty directory and recompute all manifest hashes. Expected: exact paths and bytes match; missing or changed files are reported. This is documentation recovery, not an application restore test.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Unit/sign provenance: a fixture explicitly declares 2,000 base units and a divide-by-1,000 presentation mapping. Expect 2 displayed units, with source unit and mapping version retained; reject an undeclared scale change. This verifies only the supplied fixture, not a universal PSL convention. Related F05/F06/F08/F12/F15.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Allocation rule absent: a staff-cost batch has no effective-dated approved allocation basis. Expect an unresolved allocation exception, not adoption of spoken sample ratios or today's headcount. Related F19–F22.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Period mismatch: a synthetic September report links an asset schedule labelled March without explanatory evidence. Expect a date-applicability exception for owner review, not silent relabelling. Related F07/F09/F10.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Partial formula: a source contains only a truncated external budget reference or names VLOOKUP without its expression. Expect the exact formula to remain unverified; do not fabricate a link target, match mode or month multiplier. Related F03/F11/F25.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Incomplete forecast population: a forecast is explicitly limited to major expected inflows. Expect a visible coverage limitation; do not mark the receivables ledger reconciled or complete. Related F36/F39/F42.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Transcript conflict: machine speech suggests a sign-off while the Word passage describes prices on a report. Expect a recorded evidence conflict and owner question; no signature gate is added automatically. Related B12/F28–F30.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required

specification: Isolated cash formula: a fixture explicitly supplies inflow 100, outflow 60 and opening/movement input 20. The observed cell expression gives 60. This does not validate the next month's carry-forward formula, currency, opening balance or actual receivables. Keep those checks blocked pending independent owner evidence. Related F38/F39.
basis: Proposed synthetic safeguard; owner validation and concrete fixture required
